Name: (CP) Seasonal Leah's Kids for Unique Children and Unique Children Talk
Author: allaviyu
Description:
[quote]﻿SUBMODS/ASSETS FOR THE MOD/S '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]UNIQUE CHILDREN[/url]﻿' AND/OR '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]UNIQUE CHILDREN TALK[/url]﻿﻿' BY [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/693835]SHAKLIN[/url]﻿[/quote]

[size=3][color=#f9cb9c]Note:[/color][color=#f6b26b] [/color][u]The portraits are assets to be placed within respective folders it is required to be placed in. The portraits and sprites will work unless [color=#fff2cc]Content Patcher[/color] or the [color=#fff2cc]Unique Children Mods[/color] isn't updated to the current versions or you have installed incorrectly.[/u][/size]


[quote]!! THIS IS A COMMISSION PIECE THAT WAS CONSENTED BY THE COMMISISONER TO BE SHARED !![/quote] 
[size=3]HOW TO INSTALL MY ASSETS IN REQUIRED MODS:[/size]

FOR [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]UNIQUE CHILDREN[/url] SPRITES:
[list=1]
[*]SIMPLY EXTRACT THE [CP] FILE IN YOUR [u]"Mods"[/u] FOLDER AND HAS [u]"UniqueChildren"[/u] INSTALLED.
[/list]
FOR ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]UNIQUE CHILDREN TALK[/url]﻿ PORTRAITS NAMED [PORTRAITS]:
[list]
[*]UniqueChildren Talk > assets > [u]Portraits[/u]
[/list]
[list=1]
[*]FIND THE [u]"Unique Children Talk"[/u] FOLDER IN YOUR MODS.[img]https://i.ibb.co/Sm9KnqP/step-1.jpg[/img]﻿
[*]GO TO [u]"assets"[/u] AND PASTE AND EXTRACT THE CHOSEN [u]"Portraits.zip"[/u] FILE INSIDE THE FOLDER.[img]https://i.ibb.co/YPsXFZP/step-2.jpg[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/mTmRND6/step-3-uct.jpg[/img]﻿﻿

[/list][i]
[/i]For the [u][color=#f9cb9c]Portraits[/color][/u], you [u]need[/u] to change the place holder names to your children's names. You have to do it for every single image file to work.

ex. BoyName_Spring > Name_Spring

Please do note that you've renamed them in whatever sentence case you used in naming your children in-game. (example, elijah would be elijah_Spring/CHARLOTTE would be CHARLOTTE_Spring)




[color=#f9cb9c][size=4]Hello![/size]
[/color]
After seeing the assets I've made and shared for both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29951]Sam[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21032?tab=description]Elliott[/url]﻿, I was contacted to do Leah this time! As stated before, this is a[color=#f9cb9c] commissioned piece [/color]that is, with consent from the person who commissioned me, now shared to the public! I have modeled the design of the kids with inspiration from another mod; [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12391]Alternative Leah Portraits - Seasonal[/url]﻿, at the request of the commissioner. We hope that everyone who uses this love it!

Dark bodied sprites are available now but for portraits, only those that the commissioner had requested has been made! I will add a dark-skinned portrait file when I can!

[b][size=4][i]


This is an exclusive design for this spouse and the planned[u] (WIP) Vanilla Children Sprites Overhaul[/u] for Unique Children would feature different and less complicated designs! [/i][/size][/b]




If you're interested in commissioning your own sprites and portraits, please don't hesitate to ask me here on nexus or on my [url=https://bsky.app/profile/mx-yang.bsky.social]bsky[/url] acc, or check my [url=https://midum.carrd.co]carrd[/url]! If I'm free from my academics, I'll be able﻿ help you with it!
